name: kce-estetica-automotiva
description: KCE Estética Automotiva - Lava-jato Premium Montes Claros

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['index.html','styles.css','script.js','favicon.svg','_headers','_redirects'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f); }); if(fs.existsSync('assets')) { if(!fs.existsSync('dist/assets')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/assets'); fs.readdirSync('assets').forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync('assets/' + f, 'dist/assets/' + f)); } console.log('Build synchronized to dist/');"

author: KCE
